interface.name: ukui_output_management_v1
interface.description: This interface is a manager that allows show some additional output info.

event.name: output
event.description: This event introduces a new output. This happens whenever a new output appears (e.g. a monitor is plugged in) or after the ukui_output_management_v1 is bound.

event.name: done
event.description: This event is sent after all information has been sent after binding to the output manager object and after any subsequent changes. This applies to child output as well.

interface.name: ukui_output_v1
interface.description: A output has some read-only properties: name, usable_area. These cannot be changed by clients.

event.name: name
event.description:
This event describes the name of output.
The name event is sent after a ukui_output_v1 object is created. This event is only sent once per object, and the name does not change over the lifetime of the ukui_output_v1 object.

event.name: usable_area
event.description: This event describes the usable_area of output.

event.name: finished
event.description: This event indicates that the ukui_output_v1 is no longer available. Clients should send a destroy request and release any resources associated with it.
